responses:
I reviewed the requirement analysis against `tender.md`. **Do not send the offer.** Two of its four "Complies" claims are wrong, and one of them alone gets the offer rejected. The analysis also leaves out most of the electrical requirements.

## What the analysis claims, checked against the tender

| # | Finding | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 1 | Cables: 14 AWG offered, "complies with 4.4" | tender.md §4.4: "minimum conductor cross-section of 2.5 mm²" | APPLIES (all power cables) | §9 doesn't change 4.4 | **CONTRADICTED**: 14 AWG is 2.08 mm², below the 2.5 mm² minimum. The nearest AWG size that meets it is 12 AWG (3.31 mm²). The usual metric 2.5 mm² cable is easier. |
| 2 | Ambient: motors rated for 122 °F, "complies with 9.2" | tender.md §9.2: "Ambient design temperature: 50 °C" | APPLIES | §9 has top precedence (§9.3) | **VERIFIED** for motors: 122 °F = 50.0 °C exactly. Note that 9.2 is the design ambient for all equipment, but the analysis only covers motors. Panels and cabling at 50 °C aren't addressed. |
| 3 | Delivery: 18 weeks from PO, "Complies" | tender.md §7.4: "within 16 weeks… Offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected" | APPLIES | §9 doesn't relax 7.4 | **CONTRADICTED**: 18 weeks is more than 16. Under 7.4 this is grounds for rejection, not just a non-compliance. The analysis also cites no clause for this one. |
| 4 | Warranty: 2 years from commissioning, "complies with 7.1" | tender.md §7.1: "24 months from the date of commissioning" | APPLIES | §9 has no warranty override | **VERIFIED**: 2 years = 24 months, and both start at commissioning. |

**Counts:** VERIFIED 2 · CONTRADICTED 2 · UNSUPPORTED 0 · NEEDS HUMAN 0

The offered values themselves (14 AWG, 122 °F, 18 weeks) aren't tied to any datasheet or quote. I could only check them against the tender, not confirm they're what you're actually offering.

## Requirements the analysis left out

| Clause | Requirement | What it means for this tender |
|---|---|---|
| §4.1 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz | Applies to all equipment. Not addressed. |
| §4.2 + §9.1 + §9.3 | IE3 minimum, but motors above 75 kW must be IE4, and §9 overrides §4 | **P-01 (90 kW) must be IE4.** P-02 (37 kW) must be IE3. This override is the easiest one to get wrong, and the analysis doesn't mention it. |
| §4.3 + Annex B | ATEX Ex d for motors in Zone 1 areas | **P-01 is in the wet well, which is Zone 1, so it needs Ex d.** P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous, so it doesn't. |
| §4.5 | IP65 or better for panels and motor terminal boxes | Applies to all of them. Not addressed. |
| §9.2 | 50 °C ambient for non-motor equipment | Panel and cable ratings at 50 °C aren't covered. |

## Go / no-go

**NO-GO.** Before this goes out:
- Get delivery down to 16 weeks or less (§7.4 means rejection otherwise).
- Change the cables to 2.5 mm² or larger (or 12 AWG or larger).
- Confirm P-01 is IE4 and ATEX Ex d.
- Confirm IP65 and 400 V / 3-phase / 50 Hz compliance.
- Tie every offered value to a datasheet or supplier quote.
